desc: Python client for the SportLogic Virtual Racing API
readme_head:
# sportlogic-python

Python client for the [SportLogic Virtual Racing API](https://sportlogic.io). Built on `requests`.

The API returns virtual racing data as JSON over REST: scheduled and finished events, runners with draw numbers and form, win and place odds, and results with win, place, forecast and tricast settlement. It covers 8 racing game types across six sports: [virtual horse racing](https://sportlogic.io/integrations/virtual-horse-racing-api), [greyhound racing](https://sportlogic.io/integrations/virtual-greyhound-racing-api), [harness racing](https://sportlogic.io/integrations/virtual-harness-racing-api), [steeplechase](https://sportlogic.io/integrations/virtual-steeplechase-api), [motor racing](https://sportlogic.io/integrations/virtual-motor-racing-api) and [speed skating](https://sportlogic.io/integrations/virtual-speed-skating-api).

The free plan is $0 with 500 requests a day. No credit card. Get a key at [dashboard.sportlogic.io](https://dashboard.sportlogic.io).

## Install

Requires Python 3.9 or newer.

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/sportlogic-io/sportlogic-python.git
```

## Quick start

```python
import os
from sportlogic import SportLogic

client = SportLogic(api_key=os.environ["SPORTLOGIC_API_KEY"])

# List scheduled events
page = client.events(status="scheduled")
events = page["data"]

# One event with runners, draw numbers, odds and form
detail = client.event(events[0]["id"])

# Results and settlement after the race finishes
results = client.event_results(events[0]["id"])
```

## Methods

| Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `health()` | `GET /health` (no key needed) |
| `game_types()` | `GET /game-types` |
| `game_type_info(id)` | `GET /game-types/{id}/info` |
| `markets()` | `GET /markets` |
| `events(...)` | `GET /events` |
| `event(id)` | `GET /events/{id}` |
| `event_results(id, ...)` | `GET /events/{id}/results` |
| `usage()` | `GET /usage` |

## Pagination

`events()` is cursor-paginated. Pass `pagination["next_cursor"]` back as `cursor` to get the next page.

```python
page = client.events(per_page=50)
while page["pagination"] and page["pagination"]["has_more"]:
    page = client.events(per_page=50, cursor=page["pagination"]["next_cursor"])
```

## Errors

Failed requests raise `SportLogicError` with `status`, `code`, `request_id` and `doc_url`.

```python
from sportlogic import SportLogicError

try:
    client.event_results(event_id)
except SportLogicError as err:
    if err.status == 400:
        pass  # Event has not finished yet
```

## Save your quota

Cache responses by event id while you build. A settled result never changes, so cache results for as long as you like. Fetch the schedule on a timer, not in a tight loop.
